tagline: Timed by hand, one at a time
sector: An independent mechanical watch house making five references in small runs, sold direct and through two dealers.
founded_place_size: A studio of eight in Chicago, Illinois; a Swiss-trained watchmaker and a regulator who times every piece by hand.
about: Lunara builds mechanical watches in small runs and regulates each one by hand before it ships. We sell presence, finish and the credibility of a named regulator, not a colour or a trend. Every piece leaves with its own certificate, and the pictures have to read as confidence.
audience: Collector-literate buyers, 35 to 60, who judge a watch on form, finish and the hand behind it.
price_positioning: Four to twelve thousand dollars a piece, positioned as independent horology: above fashion watchmaking and below the grand houses.

palette.name: Warm near-black
palette.role: mandatory as the type colour wherever type sits on Bone cream (small captions, footer lines and small labels excepted)
palette.usage: Type on Bone cream other than small captions, footer lines and small labels: the wordmark, headings, reference names in headings, body, specification, fine print and the timing line, as on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf, and thin frame borders, as around its photograph. It may also be a solid dark ground or panel carrying Bone cream type, as the Dealer B panel colour in lunara_notes.txt, or type set directly on a photograph.

palette.name: Bone cream
palette.role: mandatory as the type colour wherever type sits on Warm near-black or Oxblood
palette.usage: The main light ground, as on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf; all type set on Warm near-black or Oxblood; and type set directly on a photograph.

palette.name: Tempered steel
palette.usage: Small captions, footer lines, labels and dividers only, as the photo caption (a reference and serial) and the footer lines on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf. Never a ground, a panel or body text.

palette.name: Aged brass
palette.usage: Hairline rules and dividers only, as the rule under the wordmark on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf. Always a flat colour, never a metallic effect, and never type, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Oxblood
palette.role: optional ground or panel; optional small label
palette.usage: A solid panel or ground carrying Bone cream type, as the Dealer A panel colour in lunara_notes.txt, or a small label on Bone cream, as the certificate line on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf. Never body text.

voice: Exact, understated, collector to collector. Example line: 'Five references. Each one regulated by hand and signed.'
brand_assets_status: No separate logo reconstruction is commissioned. Where a Lunara Chronometry wordmark is included, set Lunara above Chronometry using the supplied current display font and tracking; do not copy the old certificate's typeface.
values: One committed warm single-tone treatment with fine grain across the whole campaign, with a single true-colour dial frame kept so a customer can judge the finish honestly.
signature_type_move: No figure is ever set in the serif: every numeral, reference, price, serial and timing result switches to Inter tabular lining, so a line of tracked capitals visibly cools wherever a number falls. Steps 01 and 02 hold the Cormorant Garamond capitals tracked 180 units, and any figure inside them drops to Inter at the same size.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Bone cream, Warm near-black or Oxblood and nothing else; the grey sweep or stone inside a supplied photograph is photography, not a designed ground. On Bone cream, the wordmark, headings (reference names in them included), body, specification, fine print and the timing line are Warm near-black, as on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf; small captions and footer lines, including a reference-and-serial caption, may instead be Tempered steel, as that card's photo caption and footer are; Oxblood may set a small label, as the certificate label on that card is. On Warm near-black or Oxblood, all type is Bone cream. Type set directly on a photograph is Bone cream or Warm near-black. Warm near-black and Bone cream are mandatory only in these type roles, so a page need not show both: a product page may set its type straight on its photograph, and a dealer sheet may run Oxblood panels. Aged brass is for hairline rules and dividers only and Tempered steel for small captions, footer lines, labels and dividers only; neither is ever a ground, a panel or body text, which keeps both to small accents. The clean white that lunara_notes.txt names is for square store tiles, and none of these outputs is a store tile.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, metallic or blend effect is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: type sits on a clear area of the photograph or on a solid panel. The warm single-tone treatment with fine grain that lunara_notes.txt sets for the campaign is a grade of the photograph itself, not an overlay.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules or icons, and no metallic, foil, gradient or glow rendering of any colour, Aged brass included: every colour is flat. The brand sells presence and finish, not a colour or a trend.
palette_rules.photography: Apart from the campaign's warm single-tone treatment that lunara_notes.txt sets, photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette. The deep blue sunray dial in lunara_pdp_vesper.jpg and the lacquered oxblood dial and strap in lunara_pdp_ardent.jpg are product colours: they are not pushed toward Bone cream, Oxblood or any other palette colour, nor read as uses of it.

creative_scope.fixed: Keep the watch's reference, case geometry, dial appearance and finish accurate. Product features and dealer information use the exact register wording. The certificate is a historical visual reference, not the current type standard.
creative_scope.designer_choices: Choose one supplied watch for the campaign, its crop and a warm treatment that does not change its dial identity. Choose product-page and dealer-sheet hierarchy within the current identity.
